01 · About

I turn vague requests into plans, and repetitive work into software

I'm a full stack engineer who likes the part before the code: taking a vague request, turning it into a plan the team can execute, and finding the manual, repetitive steps that software should be doing instead.

I write things down. Decisions, workflows and the reasons behind them go into documentation the whole team can use, so knowledge outlasts any one person or sprint. That habit is part of why I now own quarterly planning, feature scoping and new-hire onboarding, and work as an associate technical project manager / product owner.

Next, I want a role with more product ownership, or one centred on AI-assisted software development. Outside work, I keep solving problems with software;

Side project

Retail Sales & Inventory Site

Dashboards · weekly owners' report · Excel export

Problem
A multi-brand fashion retailer's daily ERP exports were only usable through Excel reports, and an earlier Streamlit and PostgreSQL app never ran reliably.
Built
A local web app that imports the exports, shows sales, inventory and sell-through, and produces the weekly owners' report. It reuses the existing ETL cleaning code, so its numbers match the Excel reports. Built with AI-assisted development; I maintain it.
